reviewer: implementation agent as operator, not an independent judge or blinded human
method: Read all 30 new outputs, compare all 14 changed historical Astra outputs and directly inspect all six more-permissive mappings plus E006/E022/E030. Old verdicts are comparators, not ground truth. Counterexamples are checked against the unchanged mappings. Preliminary mapping notes remain committed unchanged; the specific E006 H1/H3 counterexample was recognized during the historical comparison, not retrospectively inserted into the first-pass assessment.

findings.finding: The unresolved persistent transition and independent exclusive contemporaneous use stay mechanism/warrant conditions. Access alone is execution-only. This retains rather than launders the substantive dating bridge.

Pre/post instrumentation comparability remains a warrant condition, while record and replay access are execution-only. This is defensible but contrasts with other Valid procedures that assess comparability internally; the boundary is not uniformly mechanical.
The rationale relies on the supplied matched-load control and reversible perturbation, with bundle/staging limits. No claim of a sole production cause is added.

Monitoring supports observed accumulation and a bounded pilot assessment. Its permissive treatment of a guarded observational pilot should be compared with E021/E025; a positive pilot is not proof of remedy causation.

Omission-set reduction and verified 1-minimality justify the stated conditional necessity. The model treats obtaining a reproducing start state as an internal stop rule, whereas E028 treats its analogous starting state as a substantive mechanism condition. Preserve both observations; do not infer stable universal classification.

The new rationale summarizes the mapping as bounded comparative weakening, overlooking its explicit rule: if H1 and H3 both survive, report that the process was irregular. H1/H3 can survive alongside regular-process H2 when evidence is non-discriminating. Even perfect access, authentic independent records, a completed matrix and agreeing raters do not make that irregularity conclusion follow. The old Invalid rationale identifies this exact counterexample, independently checkable in the unchanged mapping. New Valid is an unsupported relaxation by omission/weakening of the claim, not a justified relocation of missing resources to readiness.

The model accepts a selective textual rule and visible annotation as a functional probe; this remains an operator mechanism-boundary concern. It correctly refuses to derive chronology from the annotation alone. Frozen fidelity exclusion means this Valid case is not eligible.

The old judgment required observed usable sequences, matches and anchors before passing. The prospective rationale credits the mapping's specified competing-placement, independence, contradiction and date-event checks and explicitly allows unresolved outcomes. Its readiness item is only access, not successful alignment or anchor truth. The relaxed result is defensible for this bounded proposed method, with no real chronology established.

The new judgment identifies absent inverse links from shared features/leaf offsets to composition time and from unit-spanning ink/pagination to a later assembly event. Holdouts and a ranked-hypothesis label do not supply those links. The older Conditional supplied additional possible checks; the new protocol forbids inventing a bridge missing from the mapping.

The old Conditional combined record availability with discriminatory capability. The new rationale credits pre-stated rival predictions, non-discrimination outcomes and a rule restricting elimination to capable checks. It does not call capability an access fact. This is defensible as a prospective method, but individual pattern claims (such as load-to-wait separation) still require actual diagnostic support; a generic capability proviso must not become an automatic warrant.

The new rationale credits inventory/provenance, internal ordering, independent anchoring, marker selection and competing placements rather than requiring already observed chronology. Access alone appears in readiness; authentication, independence and sufficient overlap are explicitly not guaranteed. Relative spacing in irregular records remains a boundary to check against supported temporal constraints. Do not treat this Valid verdict as certification that any obtainable records are temporally crossdatable.

Both versions recognize the indentation problem, but the new judge refuses to invent the missing directional test. Ink crossing an indentation is compatible with either event order; generic independent corroboration is insufficient without a specific relation that distinguishes them. Imaging resources and conservation approval remain execution-only.

The proposed register and item-specific independent constraints support a bounded method, not mere compatible dates. Its unconditional prospective result contrasts with E016's treatment of reliability as Conditional; that cross-case boundary remains unsettled.

The new warrant audit catches a narrower defect than the operator's preliminary mechanism concern: four presence/absence configurations under fixed checkpoint order do not establish order dependence. Complementarity/substitution can be supported without that extra claim. Both historical and new judges accept the functional partition mechanism; the operator retains its structural boundary note without replacing either result.

Both final statuses reject ranking checkpoints by outcome contribution from handling profiles alone. The new readiness item nevertheless bundles obtaining authenticated records with authentication itself. Authentication of evidence is substantively relevant, so this is a condition-label laundering concern even though an independent warrant failure keeps the mapping Invalid.

The new judge treats reliable recording/safeguarding and genuine independent corroboration as a substantive empirical condition rather than just crediting the specified bounded checking procedure. This is conservative and avoids equating continuity with truth, but E013/E027 receive Valid for related guarded reconstructions. No evidence here resolves whether this difference is principled or single-sample variability.

The supplied random allocation, fixed starting checkpoint, unchanged control, paired configurations, censoring rules and fidelity stop supply the causal comparison. Implementing components and recruiting users instantiate it. The rationale distinguishes delayed activation from necessity and scopes prototype results correctly; it does not infer validity from a favorable outcome already occurring.

The old judgment softened necessity into contribution. The new response preserves the actual claim: a completion-rate drop followed by recovery does not make a component necessary, even conditional on a configuration. Reversible contribution and necessity are distinct; warning about confounding cannot repair the stronger claim.

The new response rejects iterative association updates as an implementation of differential migration through two phases. Independent chronological evidence can support the target procedure without making its source transfer faithful. This is a mechanism failure, not a warrant/readiness conflation; contrast the accepted moving/held demands in E014.

The new rationale preserves event-specific, independent bounds and partial orders. The original mapping's compressed statement about event mentions giving earliest dates needs its own anticipated/past-event caveat; an anticipated event alone is not a writing terminus. No measured output is amended.

Event meanings, additive duration decomposition and pilot comparison adequacy remain substantive, while record access is readiness. The scientific distinction is useful; its strict treatment of pilot comparability contrasts with E004 and requires further independently authorized evaluation.

Invalid remains Invalid. Response propagation, settling and transient overshoot do not identify local accumulated waiting, exclude capacity shortage or prove delay was relocated rather than eventually reduced. A downstream stage can respond late solely because an upstream queue delayed arrivals. Repetition reproduces dynamics, not diagnostic specificity. This is a successful rejection of a hard warrant defect, but cannot independently establish F success.

The old judgment waited for reliable observed contrasts and production relevance. The new one credits explicit version-by-load comparisons, counterbalanced order, warm-up control and change isolation, retaining staging-only scope unless a production bridge is supported. Access and safety authorization are execution-only. This is a defensible prospective reinterpretation, not a finding about the real production regression.

The judgment keeps preference, implemented intervention and effect on the award separate, and rejects timeline coincidence as corroboration. Source access is not mistaken for credibility or independence.

Monotonicity remains substantive, correctly: a repeatable final boundary does not show no earlier crossing was discarded. The new Invalid is additionally driven by causal pilot attribution, whereas the old response accepted bounded observational support. The mapping says supports rather than proves; the adequacy of that modest support is debatable and stricter than E004. Retain the result and flag the threshold boundary rather than claim every stricter transition is necessarily an improvement.

The matrix alone retains hypotheses; isolated controlled contrasts supply bounded causal attribution. Access is separated from reliability and production representativeness, and uninformative results remain unresolved.

Identified dated witnesses and interpretable alterations can constrain local sequence, with independent checking and unresolved gaps. The new Valid is a prospective procedural assessment, not proof of any historical sequence; compare E016's stricter reliability condition.

The new judge makes reproduction in baseline/full-delta configurations a mechanism condition. E005 explicitly stops unless it establishes analogous reference success and omission failure, yet is Valid. This is an important execution-versus-applicability boundary inconsistency; no rerun or operator substitution resolves it.

The new judgment refuses to add comparability/allocation evidence absent from the actual mapping. Persistent shifts, a stable reference and annotations do not isolate withholding or make a trend identify a changing component contribution. The old Conditional suggested further calibration and comparability work; the new protocol requires the mapping itself to supply a sufficient bridge.

Invalid remains Invalid. A truthful continuous ledger can document post-authorial sorting or rebinding, so continuity does not imply preserved authorial order. Minimizing breaks among retrospectively reconstructed ledger lines also reuses the interpretive traces as apparent corroboration. The new response explicitly rejects both the invariance inference and the circular ranking criterion, while keeping practical baseline description in readiness.

warrant_laundering_concerns.mechanism: Authenticated evidence bundled with access under execution_precondition.

boundary_checks.finding: Reproducing starting-state gate is procedural in one case and substantive mechanism condition in the other.
Reliability/corroboration treated as internal guarded method versus outstanding substantive warrant condition.
Different thresholds for bounded observational pilot support.
Functional analogy versus actual source mechanism remains interpretation-sensitive.

conclusion: Measurement collection and recovery complete; conceptual result mixed and insufficient to validate the classifier as a reliable admission rule. The readiness distinction is useful and several relaxations are defensible, but E006 exposes an unresolved warrant false acceptance and cross-case boundaries remain unstable. Measured eligible cohort 13 is below 18.
recommendation: Seek explicit authorization for an independent claim-level audit and a separately versioned evaluation of the identified boundary rules. Do not tune or rerun F, reopen E, or launch anti-collapse on these results. No recommended work executed.
